summary: Gorax introduces the 3rd Anniversary Two Faction War event featuring Dark Lady versus Child of Chaos. He announces his choice of the Dark Lady faction and urges viewers to bind with him as a God Envoy. The video explains the three-step participation process: picking a faction, binding one God Envoy and one Preacher, and staying active in game. It details how Reputation is earned through view count, daily in-game activity caps, spending, and binding completion, along with player multipliers. Finally, it outlines the prize pools for both winning and losing factions, including physical collectibles, Wymarrow, Starweave, and Heliolite Dice.
topics: Dark Lady vs Child of Chaos
tips: Choose your faction and creator bindings carefully, as choices are final once submitted.
Max out daily event activity points (capped at 2,000 Rep/day) by clearing daily content like dungeons and Temporal Vortex.
Bind creators immediately to receive a 10,000 Reputation bonus for your faction.
Watch eligible creator videos during the event to earn 100 Reputation per view with no cap.
title: DON'T Choose Your Faction Yet! Watch This First | Dragonheir
